3e58e6bdc409d0498c76749dbdc044772063afdb.summary: RiskIQ's report (published 2018-09-19, research done with Volexity) describes a Magecart payment-card skimming attack on the retailer Newegg. The report says attackers registered a lookalike domain on August 13th and placed a skimmer on the checkout payment page around August 14th. It was removed on September 18th, so customers were exposed for over a month. The skimmer code reuses the basecode from the British Airways attack, adapted to Newegg's form. The report urges banks to review cards used on Newegg between August 14th and September 18th.

3e53cdc803f0b6ddc2d294d20ce39c53a914e6f9.summary: The Register reports Trend Micro's warning that the Cyclops Blink malware has infected ASUS routers, possibly to turn them into command-and-control servers for future attacks. A joint advisory from US and UK agencies said Cyclops Blink looked to be Sandworm's replacement for VPNFilter. The botnet also affects WatchGuard Firebox devices. Trend Micro believes its main purpose may be building infrastructure for attacks on high-value targets. How the malware gets onto devices is not clear; a default admin password is suspected.

3e977e4c58244ba5a0a3eb2e221be8138fd7fb3e.summary: Volexity reports zero-day exploitation of an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect firewalls, CVE-2024-3400 (CVSS 10.0). It tracks the activity as UTA0218. Exploitation was seen from March 26, 2024, and compromises were identified on April 10 and 11, 2024. The actor used a Python backdoor named UPSTYLE, reverse shells and the GOST tunnelling tool, exported firewall configuration, and moved laterally to steal Active Directory and browser credential data. Volexity assesses the actor is highly likely state-backed. A vendor fix was expected April 14, 2024.
